text_block_list.text:
Summer Training Camp begins. While the 
other students are bursting with 
motivation, Vodka ditches, declaring, "No 
way am I doing a training camp!"

However, after getting scolded by her 
father, she boarded the bus heading to the 
training camp, albeit running late.

To make summer memories with her "pals," 
Vodka's fiery training camp has begun!
